review_scope: All 28 pending controls plus the actual v2 scripts, original v1 failed review, pinned published source/assembly and private helper dependency contracts.

previous_findings.evidence: Case.ps1:30-32 disables concurrency and removes the invalid zero limit; the pinned private helper takes the existing-game refusal path.
Plain declared aliases plus Boolean context values are checked in Preflight and Driver; Commands-For validates restore keys.
Family/alias/state phase names are distinct. The static namespace has 89 phase names and 190 paths.

Actual retry03 helper pair and _checks/_box_lock hashes match. flow_run creates the PID/slot/start-ticks event, checks retained ownership before accepting it and cleans only its creation-handle process. Case requires the matching witness-hash request and terminal receipt.
All submitted v2 file hashes matched before review output was written. New R9 covers the incompatible launch/output manifest namespace.

Scene defaults are exact constructor f32 values. The driver requires the matching natural F3 display and no matching applied/rejected Debug.ini row in the complete prefix-validated private log, otherwise skips before any setter. Restore strings use round-trip source-default text. Clipping values use exact same-run four-byte reads and bitwise restore checks.
Every metadata/request/readback f32 is invariant-parsed and explicitly rejects NaN/infinity before comparison. Scene defaults and all eight f32 probes have matching finite bit pins.
E14 explicitly names the published 3f PC trap in BehaviourCollection::Prepare and caller assert. It remains pending with no jump-moment behavior credit.

findings.title: The exact package manifest rejects the mandatory runtime stage and requested review artifacts
findings.evidence: Preflight enumerates every local package file except SOURCE_PINS.json/ALL_FILE_HASHES.sha256 for source pins, and every file except the manifest for the all-file set. STAGING.json is required in the same directory for Execute but is absent from both submitted name sets. REVIEW.md/REVIEW.json are also required alongside this packet and are absent from those sets. An in-memory set comparison confirms exactly these three additions are rejected. No runtime stage was created during review.
findings.impact: The preparation-only preflight passes, but every documented staged execution fails its prelaunch preflight before game launch. These requested review files also make preparation preflight fail after review.
findings.action: Define the immutable authored-file set separately from STAGING.json, REVIEW outputs and run evidence. Validate the stage with an explicit runtime contract and preserve hashes of all immutable authored files. Do not solve this by blind manifest regeneration that absorbs arbitrary runtime files.

findings.title: The optional true-baseline SC02 anchor seed breaks the first SC01 phase
findings.evidence: When captured SC02=TRUE, scene_triangle_anchor_seed sets SC02=FALSE and leaves it there. Controls are ordered SC01 then SC02. SC01 builds Expected from captured baselines, so it expects SC02=TRUE but sets only SC01. An isolated in-memory execution of the actual Apply-Target/Get-PhaseCommands functions reports: scene_SC01_positive expects SC02=TRUE but anchor seed left FALSE. No native calls or file writes were used in this simulation.
findings.impact: The advertised optional branch aborts at the first target and enters emergency restore. The false-baseline/default branch is unaffected by this specific mismatch.
findings.action: Place the false seed immediately before SC02 positive, or restore SC02 to its captured baseline before unrelated phases while preserving evidence of the seeded anchor. Validate both natural TRUE and FALSE branches in memory.

findings.title: Private-profile physical path validation occurs after the fixture move/copy
findings.evidence: The wrapper preflight checks lexical sibling names/profile equality and hashes only. It never calls the supplied no-reparse/private-profile guards. The bound run_case moves an existing Profile.sav and copies the fixture at lines 263-273, then invokes Setup at line 297. Only Setup subsequently calls Assert-BrnPrivateProfile. A Memcard_62190/data ancestor junction can therefore pass the first lexical checks and redirect that first move/copy before the guard rejects it. The later check sees the newly copied fixture rather than establishing the original target was private.
findings.impact: The submitted runner cannot enforce its no-live-user-profile boundary before its first profile mutation. No actual redirected stage or profile mutation occurred in this review.
findings.action: Run the physical no-reparse/approved-private-root and existing-profile identity checks in the pre-invocation stage gate before run_case can move/copy any profile. Keep the under-lock Setup recheck, and preserve the private restore-on-owned-exit contract.

controls.caption: Show debug camera names
controls.consumer_observation: When the normal camera selector is cycling, this byte enables the current debug camera name text.
controls.required_live_gate: The consumer is conditional on mbCycleNormalCamSelector; do not claim a visible effect unless the cycle state is witnessed.

controls.caption: Show World Map debug
controls.consumer_observation: The original world-map debug overlay runs only with this flag and more than one vehicle-position journal record.
controls.required_live_gate: Use a moving DRIVING scene with at least two position-journal entries and an available world map.

controls.caption: Show Crash Info
controls.consumer_observation: The crash debug byte gates the original debug-print and selected-moment-render branch while the crash state is updating.
controls.required_live_gate: Require the crash state update window; if no crash state is active, raw value passes only and no visual-effect claim.

controls.caption: Small Near Clip
controls.consumer_observation: When the camera has no custom near distance and state flag 0x10000 is set, the original returns the small-near global and projection copy consumes it.
controls.required_live_gate: Require a camera with state bit 0x10000 set and no custom near distance; otherwise this value is not the active near reader.

controls.caption: Default Near Clip
controls.consumer_observation: When no custom near distance or small-near flag applies, the original selects this global and stores the resulting near plane into the CGS camera before projection update.
controls.required_live_gate: Use the standard external camera with no custom near value and small-near state bit clear; include a stable close object for the clipping ROI.

controls.caption: Default Far Clip
controls.consumer_observation: The original projection-copy path loads the default far plane, stores it into the CGS camera, and rebuilds the perspective matrix.
controls.required_live_gate: Use the same stable distant world landmark and camera pose; V6 moving-road frames did not isolate this far-clip consumer.

controls.caption: Enable Boost Effects
controls.consumer_observation: The original boost camera FOV/shake paths read the +0xB5F enable byte before applying effects.
controls.required_live_gate: Require non-zero speed and ordinary Boost input for a consumer witness; compare the same road/pose with the byte enabled and disabled.
